src: U.S. Census Bureau, cartographic boundary file cb_2020_us_cd116_500k
cd.vint: The Census Bureau's lines of the 116th Congress's districts (its file says session 116). The Bureau published no file of the 117th Congress's districts, the Congress the 2020 election chose.
rec: 2012 congressional plan, 6 districts (House Bill 302, 2012 Acts ch. 3)
Kentucky General Assembly: 2012 Regular Session House Bill 302, redistricting (congressional), Acts ch. 3, signed by the Governor
Signed 2012-02-10 (secondary source). In force 2012-2020. The cd116 file has 6 districts.

src: U.S. Census Bureau, cartographic boundary file cb_2020_us_sldu_500k
sldu.vint: The Census Bureau's 2020 file of legislative districts, the lines it records for the 2018 legislative session year. The Bureau published no file of the lines in use for 2020. Where a state's lines changed in between, the check below or the plan cited stops the map.
rec: 2013 legislative plan, 38 Senate districts (House Bill 1, 2013 Extraordinary Session, Acts ch. 1)
Kentucky General Assembly: 2013 Extraordinary Session House Bill 1, redistricting (House and Senate plans), Acts ch. 1, signed by the Governor

Signed 2013-08-23 (secondary source). The 2012 legislative plan (HB 1 of 2012) was struck by the Franklin Circuit Court on 2012-02-07 and the 2012 elections were held on the 2002 plan, so the 2013 plan took effect with the 2014 elections. 19 Senate seats (even-numbered districts) were up in 2020. The 2020 file (LSY 2018) holds it.

src: U.S. Census Bureau, cartographic boundary file cb_2020_us_sldl_500k
sldl.vint: The Census Bureau's 2020 file of legislative districts, the lines it records for the 2018 legislative session year. The Bureau published no file of the lines in use for 2020. Where a state's lines changed in between, the check below or the plan cited stops the map.
rec: 2013 legislative plan, 100 House districts (House Bill 1, 2013 Extraordinary Session, Acts ch. 1)
Kentucky General Assembly: 2013 Extraordinary Session House Bill 1, redistricting (House and Senate plans), Acts ch. 1, signed by the Governor
As the Senate entry; the same bill carries both chambers' plans. All 100 House seats were up in 2020.
